Class IuJsonbContext

java.lang.Object
iu.client.jsonb.IuJsonbContext
Direct Known Subclasses:
IuDeserializationContext, IuSerializationContext
abstract class IuJsonbContext extends Object
State shared by one serialization or deserialization call: a single options snapshot, and the property path to the value being converted.

    • failed

      JsonbException failed(String verb, RuntimeException e, JsonLocation location)
      Describes a failure that ended the call.
      Parameters:
      verb - "read" or "write"
      e - failure
      location - parser location at the time of failure; null if not reading from a parser
      Returns:
      JsonbException naming the root type, the path to the failed property, and the location; e itself if it is already a JsonbException and there is nothing to add
